lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，肩膀一沉一沉。
lines.en: I keep low, shoulders rolling.

lines.zh: 二叠纪的末路，我走过一遍。
lines.en: I walked the end of the Permian once.

lines.zh: 我的犬齿有十五厘米，很长。
lines.en: My canines are fifteen centimetres. Long.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边嗅，气味很杂。
lines.en: I walk and sniff. Many scents.

lines.zh: 我走路很沉，地面都听得见。
lines.en: Heavy tread. The ground hears me.

lines.zh: 我在最上面那一层，下面都是吃的。
lines.en: I'm at the top. Everything below is food.

lines.zh: 我压过草丛，草都不起来了。
lines.en: I pass through grass and it stays down.

lines.zh: 我从俄罗斯的化石里回来的。
lines.en: I came back from Russian fossils.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，因为没必要快。
lines.en: I walk slowly. No need to rush.

lines.zh: 我的前半身很壮，后半身短。
lines.en: Heavy at the front. Short behind.

lines.zh: 我沿着味道走，一直没偏。
lines.en: I follow the scent. Never veering.
I intend to keep this ground.
I lower my head, teeth forward.
Not far. I'll amble over.

lines.zh: 我落地的时候，土都陷下去。
lines.en: When I set down, the soil sinks.

lines.zh: 我身上的味道，别的动物都躲开。
lines.en: My smell clears other animals out.
I stand, nose working.
I lift my head and read the wind.

lines.zh: 我的牙露在外面，一直露着。
lines.en: My teeth show. They always show.
Nothing here is bigger than me.

lines.zh: 我在等，等有个东西犯错。
lines.en: I wait for something to make a mistake.

lines.zh: 我的背有点驼，走起来像压着。
lines.en: My back is humped. I move as if weighted.
The sky is bright. I don't care for it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢呼吸，肚子一起一伏。
lines.en: I breathe slowly. My belly rises and falls.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只脚，停了一下。
lines.en: I lift a foot and pause.
This stillness isn't normal.

lines.zh: 我把头转向低处，那边有动静。
lines.en: I turn my head low. Something moved there.
I don't roar. Roaring is unnecessary.

lines.zh: 我的影子很短，太阳在顶上。
lines.en: My shadow is short. The sun's overhead.
I'm deciding where to begin.
You're standing. I don't quite understand.
I lower my head, teeth first.

lines.zh: 十五厘米的犬齿，闻得出血。
lines.en: Fifteen-centimeter fangs can smell blood.
That small, and you still stand.
No hurry. Let me look at you.

lines.zh: 你退，我的犬齿还是对着你。
lines.en: You retreat, and my canines still track you.
My forelimbs are big. They'll hold you.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛动了，我看见了。
lines.en: Your eyes moved. I saw them.

lines.zh: 这一片归我，你是过路的。
lines.en: This is mine. You're passing through.
I tilt my head slowly for a better look.
I roar low.

lines.zh: 我的犬齿咬空，反被震退。
lines.en: My canines close on air and the shock shoves me back.
My shoulder drops, and all four feet plant.
Thick hide. It still splits.
I lower myself to guard my throat.
That makes me remember you.
My throat is full of sweet, bloody air.
The top of the Permian does not kneel.
The smell of blood makes me worse.
I retreat low to hide half of me.
The smell of blood. I know it.
I close in slowly. No startle.
That's one bite.

lines.zh: 我低头闻，先看看新不新鲜。
lines.en: I lower my head. Is it fresh?
Stop holding it up; set it down and turn away.
I don't snatch. I wait.
That smell makes my teeth itch.
One bite and I don't let go.

lines.zh: 活的比死的好，可我不挑。
lines.en: Living beats dead. I'm not fussy.
Done. I'll be hungry again.
You hit me and fall back.

lines.zh: 我没动，我这种身体不好推。
lines.en: I didn't move. This body doesn't push.
I step aside to let you pass.
After that, your hand bleeds.

lines.zh: 十五厘米的犬齿，正对你。
lines.en: Fifteen-centimeter canines, aimed at you.

lines.zh: 别碰我的肩膀，那是最厚的。
lines.en: Don't touch my shoulders. Thickest part.
I can't turn. Walk around.
That pressed a patch of grass flat.

lines.zh: 你退了，我就当你明白了。
lines.en: You stepped back. I'll take it you understand.
Don't stand at my flank. You'll be bitten.

lines.zh: 这种事，我不叫，她也知道。
lines.en: No call needed. She knows.

lines.zh: 我们绕着圈子，互相看着。
lines.en: We circle, watching each other.

lines.zh: 我这十五厘米的犬齿，是二叠纪的顶。
lines.en: These fifteen-centimeter fangs topped the Permian.

lines.zh: 我这十五厘米的长牙，不用于求偶。
lines.en: These fifteen-centimetre fangs aren't for courting.
This ground holds us both.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，谁也不碰谁。
lines.en: We walk abreast, never touching.

lines.zh: 天暗下来，我们各走一方。
lines.en: As it darkens we part.

lines.zh: 这个季节，只有这样的安静。
lines.en: Only this kind of quiet in this season.
I remember her scent.
I don't think about afterward.
I take it and smell blood.
Not edible. I spit.

lines.zh: 我用前爪按住，撕了一块。
lines.en: I pin it and tear a piece off.

lines.zh: 这点肉，卡在我的牙缝里。
lines.en: This scrap of meat lodges between my teeth.
Swallowed. Nothing left.
This one's decent. I'll keep it.
Stone. It jars my teeth.
I drag it behind a tree.
I sniff and drop it.

lines.zh: 地上这些，我都想尝一口。
lines.en: I want a taste of everything here.
You moved. No more pretending.

lines.zh: 我的肩胛耸起，尾巴平伸。
lines.en: My shoulders bunch and my tail runs straight.
Only one can hold this ground.
My teeth point at your throat.
I don't roar. Roaring makes you run.
I circle toward your flank.

lines.zh: 你退到树下，那树挡不住我。
lines.en: Back to a tree. It won't stop me.

lines.zh: 这一下，我不会只来一次。
lines.en: This won't come just once.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的腿，那里最先软。
lines.en: I watch your legs. They give first.
My forepaws leave the ground first.
The wind carries me your way.
I want where you stand.
I face you. Never off.
My fangs line up with your throat.
I walk slowly. Steady.
I save the long fangs for the end.

lines.zh: 十五厘米的牙，不着急用。
lines.en: Fifteen-centimeter canines — no need to rush.

lines.zh: 这一片的草，全被我压了。
lines.en: I've flattened all this grass.
I hear your breathing clearly.
Half a step to block one side.
You stopped. Now.
I press in a little closer.
You're sweating. I smell it.
I'll save the bite for last.
I'm not chasing. I'm closing.

lines.zh: 我一口咬下去，牙扣住骨头。
lines.en: I bite and my teeth catch bone.

lines.zh: 前爪按上去，把你按实了。
lines.en: My forelimbs pin you down.
That knocked you away.

lines.zh: 我把犬齿拔出来，又咬下。
lines.en: I wrench my canines free and bite again.
My canines are fifteen centimeters.

lines.zh: 打完我退开，看你还在不在动。
lines.en: I pull back to see if you still move.

lines.zh: 我先用前爪试探你的甲。
lines.en: I test your armor with one forepaw first.

lines.zh: 我用力过猛，牙磕了一下。
lines.en: Too much force. My teeth jarred.

lines.zh: 你退开，我站在原地舔牙。
lines.en: You back off, and I stand licking my teeth.

lines.zh: 这一口，是给你留的印子。
lines.en: That bite left a mark.
A dull thunder rolls in my throat.

lines.zh: 我扑空，爪子在石上刮响。
lines.en: I miss, claws screeching on stone.

lines.zh: 我从土里站起来，先甩了甩头。
lines.en: I rise out of the soil and shake my head.
The end-Permian wind again.
Greener here than I remember.
I open my jaws. A full row of teeth.
I land and the red soil dents beneath me.

lines.zh: 我闻到了很多味道，全是吃的。
lines.en: So many scents. All food.

lines.zh: 这地方没有能咬我的东西。
lines.en: Nothing here has teeth for me.

lines.zh: 我先走了一圈，认认边界。
lines.en: I walk the boundary once.

lines.zh: 我在最上面，这不用证明。
lines.en: I'm at the top. No need to prove it.

lines.zh: 俄罗斯的骨头，在红土里醒。
lines.en: Russian bones wake in the red earth.

lines.zh: 我慢慢直起身体，还是很低。
lines.en: I straighten slowly. Still low.
The stone here is red.

lines.zh: 我先看一眼四周，再决定。
lines.en: I survey first, then decide.
I see something moving.
Fire catches my back and the hide chars.

lines.zh: 我滚下坡，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and a bone cracks.
Water covers my back. I can't raise my head.
The blast flips me over.
The arrow shaft in my ribs grinds with every step.

lines.zh: 力量缠住我，爪子都抬不起来。
lines.en: Force binds me and my claws won't lift.
Hungry too long. My legs soften.
Lightning strikes and numbs me.
A black emptiness, and nothing to grip.
